title: Human Lipoprotein Pathophysiology - Subproject: Genetics of Familial Combined Hyperlipidemia
brief_summary: To conduct focused studies of lipoprotein physiology and pathophysiology in genetically characterized patients with the objectives of understanding disease mechanisms, developing better treatments, and identifying and preventing early vascular disease.
raw_criteria: All participants related to a patient with familial combined hyperlipidemia
study_population: Relatives of patients with familial combined hyperlipidemia
